title: Repo
description: A GitHub repository connected to Robot CI, including status derived from run history.

branch.description: Branch whose pushes wake Robot CI.

branches.description: Extra watched branch glob patterns beyond 'branch'. Empty means only 'branch'.

path_include.description: Path globs a push must touch to start a run. Null means unset (built-in default set); an empty array is configured as 'no patterns'.

path_exclude.description: Path globs subtracted from path_include. Null means unset (built-in default set); an empty array disables the defaults.

filters_source.description: Where the branch and path filters came from. 'robotci.yaml' once a checkout has been read.

status.description: Running while any run is non-terminal.
